package rulefixtures

import (
	"io"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for upstream_http_call_per_item_in_handler_loop: Upstream HTTP calls made per item inside handler loops.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.
func scenario339Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, ids []string) error {
	for _, id := range ids {
		resp, err := http.Get("https://api.example.com/users/" + id)
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return err
		}
		io.Copy(io.Discard, resp.Body)
		resp.Body.Close()
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	return nil
}
